Specification: This module specifies the translation from the abstract syntax tree of a global-naming PlusCal algorithm into its corresponding TLA+ specification. It defines the abstract syntax tree grammar as sets and predicates over records and sequences, and then defines a translation pipeline that explodes structured labeled statements, translates calls/returns/gotos, adds subscripts for process-local variables, and finally constructs Init, Next, Spec, and a Termination property. The file also models fairness options for the translation output, supporting no fairness, weak fairness of process actions, weak fairness of Next, and strong fairness of process actions; it is written to be executable by TLC and includes many comments about limitations, errors, formatting, and implementation hacks.
AssumptionNames:
/\ IF IsAlgorithm(ast)
      THEN PrintSeq(Translation(ast, fairness))
      ELSE Print("<<Error", TRUE)
 /\ PrintT("@@END@@")

IF Len(ParamsAssignment.ass) > 0 THEN <<ParamsAssignment>> ELSE << >> (in SetPrcdVarsOnCall)
IF Len(PVblsAssignment.ass) > 0 THEN <<PVblsAssignment>> ELSE << >> (in SetPrcdVarsOnCall)
IF Len(ParamsAssignment.ass) > 0 THEN <<ParamsAssignment>> ELSE << >> (in RestorePrcdVarsFrom)
IF Len(PVblsAssignment.ass) > 0 THEN <<PVblsAssignment>> ELSE << >> (in RestorePrcdVarsFrom)
IF crtn.to # crtn.from THEN << AssSeqToMultiAss(...) >> ELSE SetPrcdVarsOnCall(crtn, cprcd) (in XlateCallReturn)
IF IsLabelSeq(stmts) THEN ... ELSE ErrorVal (in FullyExplodeSeq)
IF stmts = << >> THEN << >> ELSE LET ... (in FullyExplodeSeq)
IF i = Len(lsseq) THEN next ELSE lsseq[i+1].label (in FullyExplodeSeq)
IF rest = << >> THEN ... ELSE LET callVal == CASE ... IN PV[callVal.done, callVal.stk, callVal.rest] (in ProcessVars)
IF stk = << >> THEN done ELSE done \o <<"Error", "unmatched [s">> (in ProcessVars)
IF Len(rest) < 3 THEN Error("premature end") ELSE IF rest[3] \in {":", "|->"} THEN ... ELSE ... (in ProcessVars)
IF stk = <<>> THEN Error("Extra ]") ELSE ... (in ProcessVars)
IF /\ stk # << >> /\ Head(stk) = TRUE /\ \/ Len(rest) < 3 \/ rest[3] \in {":", "|->"} THEN IF Len(rest) < 3 THEN Error("premature end") ELSE ... ELSE ... (in ProcessVars)
IF \/ Len(rest) < 3 \/ rest[3] # "\"" THEN Error("unmatched quote") ELSE ... (in ProcessVars)
IF Head(rest) \in vars THEN addExpr ELSE << >> (in ProcessVars)

IF ass = << >> THEN << >> ELSE << [lhs |-> IF ass[1].lhs.var \in vars THEN [ass[1].lhs EXCEPT !.sub = sub \o PV(@)] ELSE [ass[1].lhs EXCEPT !.sub = PV(@)], rhs |-> PV(ass[1].rhs)] >> \o DoAss[Tail(ass)] (in AddSubscript)
IF \A i \in 1..Len(sseq) : IsSimpleStmt(sseq[i]) THEN ... ELSE (\A i \in 1..Len(sseq) : (IF IsSimpleStmt(sseq[i]) THEN TRUE ELSE Print(sseq[i], TRUE))) /\ ErrorVal (in AddSubscript)
IF sseq = << >> THEN << >> ELSE CASE ... (in AddSubscript)
IF i % 2 = 0 THEN "," ELSE s[(i + 1) \div 2] (in CommaSeq)
IF s = << >> THEN << >> ELSE <<",">> \o CommaSeq(s) (in AppendCommaSeq)
IF i % 2 = 0 THEN <<",">> ELSE s[(i + 1) \div 2] (in CommaConcatSeq)
IF i % 2 = 0 THEN IF i > 1 THEN <<")", "/\\", "(">> ELSE << >> ELSE eseq[(i + 1) \div 2] (in MakeConj)
IF i % 2 = 0 THEN IF i > 1 THEN <<")", "\\union", "(">> ELSE << >> ELSE eseq[(i + 1) \div 2] (in MakeUnion)
IF i % 2 = 0 THEN <<"\\/">> ELSE eseq[(i + 1) \div 2] (in MakeDisj)
IF i % 2 = 0 THEN <<")", "\\/", "(">> ELSE eseq[(i + 1) \div 2] (in MakeBigDisj)
IF i = 0 THEN << >> ELSE AddOne(UpTo[i-1], s[i]) (in XlateStmtSeq)
IF \E j \in 1..Len(ss) : ss[j].var = elt.lhs.var THEN ... ELSE Append(ss, [var |-> elt.lhs.var, comp |-> <<[sub |-> elt.lhs.sub, rhs |-> elt.rhs]>>]) (in XlateStmtSeq)
IF /\ Len(gped[i].comp) = 1 /\ gped[i].comp[1].sub = << >> THEN PV(pvars, gped[i].comp[1].rhs) ELSE <<"[", gped[i].var, "EXCEPT">> \o ... \o <<"]">> (in XlateStmtSeq)
IF varSeq = << >> THEN << >> ELSE << <<"UNCHANGED">> \o (IF Len(varSeq) = 1 THEN <<varSeq[1]>> ELSE << "<<" >> \o CommaSeq(varSeq) \o << ">>" >>) >> (in XlateStmtSeq)
IF \A i \in 1..Len(ss) : IsSimpleStmt(ss[i]) THEN ... ELSE ErrorVal (in XlateStmtSeq)
IF ss = << >> THEN [conj |-> << >>, vars |-> vars] ELSE CASE ... (in XlateStmtSeq)

IF Head(ss).eqOrIn = "=" THEN <<"LET", Head(ss).var, "==">> \o PV(SeqToSet(vars), Head(ss).exp) \o <<"IN">> ELSE <<"\\E", Head(ss).var, "\\in">> \o PV(SeqToSet(vars), Head(ss).exp) \o <<":">> (in XlateStmtSeq)
IF (localVars # {}) /\ (localSub = <<"self">>) THEN <<"(", "self", ")">> ELSE << >> (in XlateLabeledStmtSeq)
IF alg.type = "uniprocess" THEN {} ELSE ... (in LocalVars)
IF alg.procs[i].eqOrIn = "\\in" THEN ProcessVarSeq(alg.procs[i]) ELSE << >> (in LocalVars)
IF alg.prcds # << >> THEN {"@stack@"} ELSE {} (in LocalVars)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN SeqConcat([i \in 1..Len(alg.procs) |-> ProcessVarSeq(alg.procs[i])]) ELSE << >> (in NonGlobalVarsSeq)
IF lss = << >> THEN << >> ELSE <<lss[1].label>> \o ... \o LSSeq[Tail(lss)] (in LabelsOf)
IF ls = << >> THEN << >> ELSE LET last == ls[Len(ls)] IN IF last.type \in {"labelIf", "labelEither"} THEN ... ELSE << >> (in LabelsOf)
IF last.type = "labelIf" THEN ... ELSE SeqConcat(...) (in LabelsOf)
IF lss[1].stmts[1].type = "while" THEN ... ELSE LS[lss[1].stmts] (in LabelsOf)
IF localVars = {} THEN << >> ELSE <<"(", "self", ")">> (in PrcdNext)
IF localVars = {} THEN <<labels[i]>> ELSE <<labels[i], "(", "self", ")">> (in PrcdNext)
IF Multiprocess THEN <<"[", "self", "\\in", "ProcSet", "|->">> \o varval(i) \o << "]">> ELSE pdecls[i].val (in PrcdInit)
IF proc.eqOrIn = "=" THEN proc.id ELSE <<"self">> (in ProcNext)
IF proc.eqOrIn = "=" THEN <<proc.name, "==">> ELSE <<proc.name, "(", "self", ")" , "==">> (in ProcNext)
IF proc.eqOrIn = "=" THEN <<labels[i]>> ELSE <<labels[i], "(", "self", ")">> (in ProcNext)

IF proc.eqOrIn = "=" THEN proc.decls[i].val ELSE IF proc.decls[i].eqOrIn = "=" THEN <<"[", "self", "\\in">> \o proc.id \o <<"|->">> \o varval(i) \o <<"]">> ELSE <<"[">> \o proc.id \o <<"->">> \o varval(i) \o <<"]">> (in ProcInit)
IF alg.prcds # << >> THEN <<"@stack@">> ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF ngvseq = << >> THEN << >> ELSE <<"VARIABLES">> \o CommaSeq(ngvseq) (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN <<"@stack@", "=", "[", "self", "\\in", "ProcSet", "|->", "<<", ">>", "]" >> ELSE <<"@stack@", "=", "<<", ">>">> (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN ... ELSE <<"@pc@", "=">> \o Quote(alg.body[1].label) (in Translation)
IF i > 1 THEN << "[]" >> ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN ProcsInit ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF alg.prcds # << >> THEN <<StackInit>> ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF alg.procs[i].eqOrIn = "=" THEN <<alg.procs[i].id>> ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF alg.procs[i].eqOrIn = "\\in" THEN <<alg.procs[i].id>> ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF procIds # << >> THEN <<"{">> \o CommaConcatSeq(procIds) \o <<"}">> ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF (procIds # << >>) /\ (procSets # << >>) THEN <<"\\union">> ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF procSets # << >> THEN MakeUnion(procSets) ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN <<"(", "\\E", "self", "\\in", "ProcSet", ":" , alg.prcds[i].name, "(", "self", ")", ")">> ELSE <<alg.prcds[i].name>> (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN ... ELSE [i \in 1.. Len(LabelsOf(alg.body)) |-> <<LabelsOf(alg.body)[i]>>] (in Translation)
IF alg.procs[i].eqOrIn = "=" THEN <<alg.procs[i].name>> ELSE <<"(", "\\E", "self", "\\in">> \o alg.procs[i].id \o <<":", alg.procs[i].name, "(", "self", ")", ")" >> (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN << "\\E", "self", "\\in", "ProcSet", ":", "@pc@", "[", "self", "]", "=">> ELSE <<"@pc@", "=">> (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "uniprocess" THEN << wsf, "(", "Next", ")" >> ELSE MakeConj(...) (in Translation)

IF alg.procs[i].eqOrIn = "=" THEN << wsf, "(", alg.procs[i].name , ")" >> ELSE << "\\A", "self", "\\in">> \o alg.procs[i].id \o << ":", wsf, "(", alg.procs[i].name , "(", "self", ")", ")" >> (in Translation)
IF seq[i] = "@pc@" THEN "pc" ELSE IF seq[i] = "@stack@" THEN "stack" ELSE seq[i] (in Translation)
IF alg.defs = << >> THEN AllVarDecl ELSE GlobalVarDecl \o alg.defs \o NonGlobalVarDecl (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN ProcSetDef ELSE << >> (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "multiprocess" THEN ProcsNextDef ELSE MainNextDef (in Translation)
IF alg.type = "uniprocess" THEN <<"@pc@", "=" >> ELSE <<"\\A", "self" , "\\in" , "ProcSet", ":", "@pc@", "[", "self", "]", "=" >> (in Translation)
IF 25*(i + 1) > Len(s) THEN PrintT(SubSeq(s, 25*i+1, Len(s))) ELSE PrintT(SubSeq(s, 25*i + 1, 25*(i + 1))) (in PrintSeq)
IF IsAlgorithm(ast) THEN PrintSeq(Translation(ast, fairness)) ELSE Print("<<Error", TRUE) (in ASSUME)
CaseExpr: CASE tp = "SimpleStmt" -> ... [] tp = "With" -> ... [] tp = "If" -> ... [] tp = "Either" -> ... (in IsSimpleStmt)

CASE tp = "LabeledStmt" -> ... [] tp = "While" -> ... [] tp = "LabelSeq" -> ... [] tp = "LabelIf" -> ... [] tp = "LabelEither" -> ... [] tp = "FinalStmt" -> ... [] tp = "FinalIf" -> ... [] tp = "FinalEither" -> ... [] tp = "FinalWith" -> ... (in IsStmt)
CASE s[Len(s)].type \in {"call", "return", "callReturn", "goto"} -> ... [] s[Len(s)].type = "if" -> ... [] s[Len(s)].type = "either" -> ... [] s[Len(s)].type = "with" -> ... (in Explode/DoLabelSeq)

CASE last.type = "if" -> ... [] last.type = "either" -> ... [] last.type = "with" -> ... [] last.type = "call" -> ... [] last.type = "return" -> ... [] last.type = "callReturn" -> ... [] last.type = "goto" -> ... [] OTHER -> stmts (in FullyExplodeSeq/RemoveCAndR)
CASE Head(rest) = "[" -> ... [] Head(rest) = "]" -> ... [] Head(rest) = "." -> ... [] Head(rest) = "," -> ... [] Head(rest) = "\"" -> ... [] OTHER -> ... (in ProcessVars)
CASE eseq = << >> -> << "TRUE" >> [] Len(eseq) = 1 -> <<"(">> \o eseq[1] \o <<")">> [] OTHER -> ... (in MakeConj)
CASE eseq = << >> -> << "Error: empty union" >> [] Len(eseq) = 1 -> <<"(">> \o eseq[1] \o <<")">> [] OTHER -> ... (in MakeUnion)
CASE eseq = << >> -> << "FALSE" >> [] Len(eseq) = 1 -> eseq[1] [] OTHER -> ... (in MakeDisj)
CASE eseq = << >> -> << "FALSE" >> [] Len(eseq) = 1 -> eseq[1] [] OTHER -> ... (in MakeBigDisj)
CASE gped[i].var \in pvars -> ... [] gped[i].var \notin allVars -> ... [] OTHER -> ... (in XlateStmtSeq/XlateAss)

CASE Head(ss).type = "assignment" -> ... [] Head(ss).type = "when" -> ... [] Head(ss).type = "print" -> ... [] Head(ss).type = "assert" -> ... [] Head(ss).type = "skip" -> ... [] Head(ss).type = "with" -> ... [] Head(ss).type = "if" -> ... [] Head(ss).type = "either" -> ... (in XlateStmtSeq/XSS)

CASE fairnessOption = "" -> << >> [] fairnessOption = "wf" -> <<"/\\">> \o Fairness("WF_vars") [] fairnessOption = "sf" -> <<"/\\">> \o Fairness("SF_vars") [] fairnessOption = "wfNext" -> << "/\\", "WF_vars", "(", "Next", ")" >> (in Translation)
FunctionConstructor:
[tp \in {"SimpleStmt", "With", "If", "Either"},
          st \in Object] ==
            CASE tp = "SimpleStmt" -> 
                      \/ st \in Assign \cup When \cup PrintS \cup AssertS 
                                 \cup Skip
                      \/ ISS["With", st]
                      \/ ISS["If", st]
                      \/ ISS["Either", st]
            []   tp = "With"       -> 
                      /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "var", "eqOrIn", "exp", "do"})
                      /\ st.type   = "with"
                      /\ st.var    \in Variable
                      /\ st.eqOrIn \in {"=", "\\in"}
                      /\ st.exp    \in Expr
                      /\ Len(st.do) > 0
                      /\ \A i \in 1..Len(st.do) : 
                            ISS["SimpleStmt", st.do[i]]
            []   tp = "If"         -> 
                      /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "test", "then", "else"})
                      /\ st.type =  "if"
                      /\ st.test \in Expr
                      /\ \A i \in 1..Len(st.then) : 
                            ISS["SimpleStmt", st.then[i]]
                      /\ \A i \in 1..Len(st.else) : 
                            ISS["SimpleStmt", st.else[i]]
            []   tp = "Either"     ->
                      /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "ors"})
                      /\ st.type =  "either"
                      /\ IsSeq(st.ors)
                      /\ \A n \in 1 .. Len(st.ors) :
                            \A i \in 1..Len(st.ors[n]) : 
                               ISS["SimpleStmt", st.ors[n][i]]

[tp \in {"LabeledStmt", "While", "LabelSeq", "LabelIf", 
                  "LabelEither", "FinalStmt", "FinalIf", "FinalEither", 
                  "FinalWith"},
          st \in Object] ==
        CASE tp = "LabeledStmt" -> 
               /\ IsRecord(st, {"label", "stmts"})
               /\ st.label \in Label
               /\ \/ /\ IsT["While", st.stmts[1]]
                     /\ IsT["LabelSeq", Tail(st.stmts)]
                  \/ IsT["LabelSeq", st.stmts]

        []   tp = "While" -> 
               /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "test", "unlabDo", "labDo"})
               /\ st.type = "while"
               /\ st.test \in Expr
               /\ IsT["LabelSeq", st.unlabDo]
               /\ \A i \in 1..Len(st.labDo) : IsT["LabeledStmt", st.labDo[i]]

        []   tp = "LabelSeq" ->  
               \/ IsSimpleStmtSeq(st)
               \/ /\ Len(st) > 0
                  /\ IsSimpleStmtSeq(Front(st))
                  /\ \/ IsT["LabelIf", st[Len(st)]]
                     \/ IsT["LabelEither", st[Len(st)]]
                     \/ IsT["FinalStmt", st[Len(st)]]

        []   tp = "LabelIf" -> 
               /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "test", "unlabThen", "labThen",
                                "unlabElse", "labElse"})
               /\ st.type = "labelIf"
               /\ st.test \in Expr
               /\ IsT["LabelSeq", st.unlabThen]
               /\ \A i \in 1..Len(st.labThen) :
                      IsT["LabeledStmt", st.labThen[i]]
               /\ IsT["LabelSeq", st.unlabElse]
               /\ \A i \in 1..Len(st.labElse) :
                      IsT["LabeledStmt", st.labElse[i]]

        []   tp = "LabelEither" ->
               /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "clauses"})
               /\ st.type = "labelEither"
               /\ IsSeq(st.clauses)
               /\ \A n \in 1..Len(st.clauses) :
                     /\ IsRecord(st.clauses[n], {"unlabOr", "labOr"})
                     /\ IsT["LabelSeq", st.clauses[n].unlabOr]
                     /\ \A i \in 1..Len(st.clauses[n].labOr) :
                            IsT["LabeledStmt", st.clauses[n].labOr[i]]

        []   tp = "FinalStmt" ->
               \/ st \in (CallOrReturn \cup Goto)
               \/ IsT["FinalIf", st]
               \/ IsT["FinalEither", st]
               \/ IsT["FinalWith", st]

        []   tp = "FinalIf" -> 
               /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "test", "then", "else"})
               /\ st.type = "if"
               /\ st.test \in Expr
               /\ \/ IsSimpleStmtSeq(st.then)
                  \/ /\ Len(st.then) > 0
                     /\ IsT["FinalStmt", st.then[Len(st.then)]]
                     /\ IsSimpleStmtSeq(Front(st.then))
               /\ \/ IsSimpleStmtSeq(st.else)
                  \/ /\ Len(st.else) > 0
                     /\ IsT["FinalStmt", st.else[Len(st.else)]]
                     /\ IsSimpleStmtSeq(Front(st.else))

        []   tp = "FinalEither" ->
               /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "ors"})
               /\ st.type = "either"
               /\ IsSeq(st.ors)
               /\ \A n \in 1..Len(st.ors) :
                    \/ IsSimpleStmtSeq(st.ors[n])
                    \/ /\ Len(st.ors[n]) > 0
                       /\ IsT["FinalStmt", st.ors[n][Len(st.ors[n])]]
                       /\ IsSimpleStmtSeq(Front(st.ors[n]))

        []   tp = "FinalWith" -> 
               /\ IsRecord(st, {"type", "var", "eqOrIn", "exp", "do"})
               /\ st.type = "with"
               /\ st.var \in Variable
               /\ st.eqOrIn \in {"=", "\\in"}
               /\ st.exp \in Expr
               /\ Len(st.do) > 0
               /\ \/ IsSimpleStmtSeq(st.do) 
                  \/ /\ IsT["FinalStmt", st.do[Len(st.do)]]
                     /\ IsSimpleStmtSeq(Front(st.do))

[i \in 1..Len(lsseq) |->
                     Explode(lsseq[i], IF i = Len(lsseq) 
                                         THEN next
                                         ELSE lsseq[i+1].label)]

[n \in 1..Len(ethr.clauses) |->
                                     DoLabelSeq[
                                      ethr.clauses[n].unlabOr,
                                      IF ethr.clauses[n].labOr = << >>
                                       THEN nxt
                                       ELSE Head(ethr.clauses[n].labOr).label]]

[i \in 1..Len(seq) |-> IF seq[i] = "@pc@" 
                               THEN "pc"
                               ELSE IF seq[i] = "@stack@" 
                                      THEN "stack"
                                      ELSE seq[i] ]

[i \in 1..(2*Len(eseq)-1) |-> 
                         IF i % 2 = 0 THEN IF i > 1 THEN <<")", "/\\", "(">>
                                                    ELSE << >>
                                      ELSE eseq[(i + 1) \div 2]]

[i \in 1..(2*Len(eseq)-1) |-> 
                      IF i % 2 = 0 THEN IF i > 1 THEN <<")", "\\union", "(">>
                                                 ELSE << >>
                                   ELSE eseq[(i + 1) \div 2]]

[conj |-> 
              [i \in 1..Len(gped) |->
                CASE gped[i].var \in pvars ->
                      <<"Error", ":", "multiple assignment to variable",
                         gped[i].var>>

                []   gped[i].var \notin allVars ->
                      <<"Error", ":", "assignment to undeclared variable",
                         gped[i].var>>
 
                []   OTHER ->
                       <<gped[i].var, "'", "=" >>   
                          \o
                       (IF /\ Len(gped[i].comp) = 1
                           /\ gped[i].comp[1].sub = << >>
                          THEN PV(pvars, gped[i].comp[1].rhs)
                          ELSE <<"[", gped[i].var, "EXCEPT">>
                                 \o
                               CommaConcatSeq([j \in 1..Len(gped[i].comp) |->
                                           <<"!">> \o  
                                            PV(pvars, gped[i].comp[j].sub)
                                             \o
                                           <<"=">>
                                             \o
                                            PV(pvars, gped[i].comp[j].rhs)
                                         ])
                                  \o
                                <<"]">>
                        ) 
               ],
             vars  |-> vars \o [i \in 1..Len(gped) |-> gped[i].var]]

[i \in 1..Len(proc.decls) |-> 
                  <<proc.decls[i].var, proc.decls[i].eqOrIn>> 
                   \o
                  (IF proc.eqOrIn = "="
                     THEN proc.decls[i].val
                     ELSE IF proc.decls[i].eqOrIn = "="
                            THEN <<"[", "self", "\\in">> \o proc.id \o
                                 <<"|->">> \o varval(i)  \o <<"]">>
                            ELSE <<"[">> \o proc.id \o <<"->">> \o
                                 varval(i) \o <<"]">>)]

[i \in 1..Len(alg.procs) |->
                           (IF i > 1 THEN << "[]" >> ELSE << >>) \o
                           <<"self", alg.procs[i].eqOrIn>> \o
                            alg.procs[i].id \o <<"->">> \o
                            Quote(alg.procs[i].body[1].label)]

[i \in 1..Len(alg.procs) |-> 
                    IF alg.procs[i].eqOrIn = "="
                      THEN <<alg.procs[i].name>>
                      ELSE <<"(", "\\E", "self", "\\in">> \o
                           alg.procs[i].id \o 
                          <<":", alg.procs[i].name, "(", "self", ")", ")" >> ]

[i \in 1..Len(alg.procs) |->
                           IF alg.procs[i].eqOrIn = "="
                             THEN << wsf, "(", alg.procs[i].name , ")" >>
                             ELSE << "\\A", "self", "\\in">> 
                                    \o alg.procs[i].id 
                                    \o << ":",
                                      wsf, "(", alg.procs[i].name , 
                                                "(", "self", ")", ")" >>
                         ]
FunctionApplication: DoLabelSeq[ lif.unlabThen, IF lif.labThen = << >> THEN nxt ELSE Head(lif.labThen).label]
DoLabelSeq[ lif.unlabElse, IF lif.labElse = << >> THEN nxt ELSE Head(lif.labElse).label]
DoLabelSeq[ ethr.clauses[n].unlabOr, IF ethr.clauses[n].labOr = << >> THEN nxt ELSE Head(ethr.clauses[n].labOr).label]
DoLabelSeq[while.unlabDo, IF while.labDo = <<>> THEN ls.label ELSE Head(while.labDo).label]
Explode(lsseq[i], IF i = Len(lsseq) THEN next ELSE lsseq[i+1].label)
